svg.title: Inside step 22: public activation dispatch remains in progress. Permission and planning are source-landed; durable records, guarded transports and grant/reserve/SQL are source-landed in .183 commit 8f1b9a1. Completion, consume/release and the public route remain todo.
svg.desc: Seven named display facets explain existing activation step 22 without adding milestones, a completion denominator or an effort percentage. PLAN, Permission + planning, is source-landed: permission d3f846916e121b18d57e9979c700aaa1000d4969, durable claim 4f9185c and private planning 4fc61c341420b96e785973f5c3cdd3c49748b97f. RECORDS, Durable stage records; IO, Guarded transports; and SQL, Grant / reserve / SQL, are source-landed in .183 commit 8f1b9a1c8b2cd6f31eac87ac169636ec3280b965. COMPLETE, Completion continuation; RELEASE, Consume / release continuation; and HTTP, Public route + cookie, remain todo. Each facet has a visible stable key, name and written status; color and hover are not required. Criteria are in the activation-dispatch-detail source ledger. Existing activation totals remain 21/26 source-landed, 1 active and 4 other open; project 34/46 and production 0/6 verified are unchanged. Private SQL observations do not close public dispatch or authorize completion, token release or cookie issuance. Source only: unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned, with no deployed or current-session claim.
